Hi Vivek / team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Our engineering leadership wants a short architecture deep-dive followed immediately by a live load test/demo focused on token throughput and tail latency. High level ask: validate a 10k tokens/sec sustained target across a 4k-context LLM for our baseline workload, and identify any obvious bottlenecks.

Proposed slot: Wednesday, Apr 13, 1:00–2:30pm PT. We can provide two SREs and an app engineer (attached current traffic profile).

Could you confirm who from your side should present architecture + who will run the load test? Also, any preferred runbook or checklist you want us to fill out before the session?

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and the traffic profile.

Quick answers up front:
- I'll lead the architecture deep-dive (serving runtime, batching, KV cache behavior, quantization profile implications).
- Marissa will own the load-test orchestration and telemetry (collection of p95/p99 latencies, GPU utilization, token/sec).
- Karthik and Neha will join for kernel/compilation and routing fallback discussions.

Agenda (proposed):
1) 15m architecture overview (Vivek)
2) 30m demo: steady-state generation at target tokens/sec + telemetry (Marissa)
3) 20m bottleneck analysis and quick tuning (Karthik/Neha)
4) 10m next steps / action items

Before the session please share: preferred RL/seq lengths for the test, a representative prompt set, and whether you want us to run with your model artifact or a verified open checkpoint.

I attached a short internal checklist and our recommended checklist for token-throughput runs. Can you confirm the attendee list and whether the proposed slot (Apr 13, 1pm PT) still works? If anything changes, we can shift to Apr 14 morning.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Inference — Redwood Inference

Adding a few practical notes from the load-test side:
- Can Acme provision a short-lived API key with the same rate limits you expect in prod? That will let us validate routing and throttling behaviors accurately.
- We prefer to run an initial 15-minute ramp, then two 20-minute steady windows at target throughput. Please confirm whether 10k tokens/sec is an absolute SLA or a target to explore tradeoffs.
- We’ll collect: per-token latency histogram, p50/p95/p99, GPU mem & PCIe counters, and the runtimes' batching statistics. We can stream telemetry live to your SREs or share a post-run dashboard.

Small timing note: Vivek and I have recurring commitments at 1:00pm PT on Apr 13 — could we shift to 2:00–3:30pm PT instead? That still leaves room for the 90m plan but starts a bit later. If that doesn't work we can do Apr 14 9:00–10:30am PT.

Marissa Cole
SRE / Performance Engineering, Redwood Inference
